scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Move left,
move right~!
And step...!
Dancing can be
more than a hobby.
For me, it's a way of life~
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
向左，向右~！
再迈一步...！
舞蹈不只是爱好，对我来说，更是一种生活方式~

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
The land of Midgard
is in need of talented women
to subtly change the balances
in the battle between good
and evil.
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
米德加尔特需要有才华的女性，以巧妙的方式改变正邪之战的力量对比。

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Are you ready
to take up this role,
and become a Gypsy?
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
你准备好肩负这份使命，成为冷艳舞姬了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Congratulations!
As a Gypsy, I know
that your performances
sway the hearts of all
those who will be watching...
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
恭喜！
我相信，身为冷艳舞姬，你的表演会打动每一位观众的心...

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
在这里安心休息吧。
向勇士们致敬！
